entry.title: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
entry.summary: We’re donating Agent Skills, the open standard that gives AI agents specialized knowledge and workflows, to the Agentic AI Foundation. entry.title: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks
